title: Port viewport-only command queue and direct routing
scope: Complete inScene helper: immediate direct factory call for non-scene commands; ordered scene promise chaining with failure recovery. Reuse the private owned queue rather than duplicate a scheduler.
acceptance: Full pinned registry graph runs independently generated schedules first; compare factory order, direct identity/synchronous throws and all caller outcomes.
Rejected/throwing scene jobs release the next turn, non-scene jobs bypass waiting, borrowed non-Clone values remain owned and abandoned native work is an explicit host failure.
open_items: Compare complete helper; command deadline/executor/actual viewport runtime integration remain separate.
